hero: From derivatives to a research paper, one lesson at a time.

modules.name: Math Fundamentals
modules.desc: The mathematical foundations you need for AI research — from functions and derivatives to information theory and SVD.

modules.name: Core AI Intuitions
modules.desc: Build deep intuition for the core operations that power all of AI — dot products, softmax, broadcasting, and norms.

modules.name: PyTorch Fundamentals
modules.desc: Master the tensor operations that are the building blocks of every neural network implementation.

modules.name: TensorFlow Fundamentals
modules.desc: Learn TensorFlow from the ground up — linear models, CNNs, transfer learning, adversarial examples, NLP, reinforcement learning, and more.

modules.name: Neural Network from Scratch
modules.desc: Build neural networks from the ground up — single neurons, layers, training loops, normalization, and optimization.

modules.name: Transformers
modules.desc: The architecture that changed everything — attention mechanisms, self-attention, and building GPT from scratch.

modules.name: Reinforcement Learning
modules.desc: How agents learn from interaction — from basic environments to PPO and modern LLM reasoning techniques.

modules.name: LLM From Scratch
modules.desc: Build state-of-the-art large language models from scratch — LLaMA 4, DeepSeek V3, Qwen 3, and more.

modules.name: Write Research Paper
modules.desc: The complete workflow from coding experiments to writing and publishing an AI research paper.

modules.name: How to Fine-Tune Models
modules.desc: From LoRA to full fine-tuning — learn to adapt pre-trained models to your data and tasks.

modules.name: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps)
modules.desc: Deploy and maintain ML models in production — from Git and Docker to Kubernetes, CI/CD, and monitoring with Prometheus & Grafana.

modules.name: Bonus Lessons
modules.desc: Advanced topics — training dynamics, activation functions, and cutting-edge reasoning architectures.
